s.how: Pat 400g cheese curds or halved cherry bocconcini dry and freeze 20 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, half a tsp garlic powder, 1 egg and 200ml cold lager into a smooth batter. Dust the cheese in flour, dip in batter and fry in batches at 185C for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. For ranch, mix 100g sour cream, 60ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp mayo, chives, dill and garlic.

s.n: Psych-out pretzel bites with beer cheese
s.note: the psych-out at the free throw line
s.how: Heat the oven to 220C. Roll 500g pizza dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Simmer 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip the bites for 15 seconds. Drain, place on lined trays, brush with egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake 10 to 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 150ml milk and 100ml lager, then 200g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard until smooth.

m.note: the Milwaukee Beers, Coop and Remer's team
m.how: Put 8 bratwurst in a wide pan with 2 sliced onions, 2 x 375ml cans of lager and 20g butter. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. Lift out the sausages and grill on a hot barbecue for 6 to 8 minutes until charred. Boil the onions in the beer until most of it evaporates and they're sticky. Toast 8 long rolls and fill with a bratwurst, onions, warmed sauerkraut (300g) and hot mustard.

w.note: the driveway game where BASEketball was born
w.how: Heat 150ml cream, 100g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp golden syrup and 20g butter in a saucepan, stirring until smooth and glossy, about 3 minutes. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 bowls. Pour over the warm fudge sauce. Top each with salted peanuts (60g total), crushed pretzels (40g total), a swirl of whipped cream (150ml) and a maraschino cherry.

d.note: the Denslow Cup, the trophy the Beers are chasing
d.how: In each of 4 rocks glasses, muddle 1 orange slice, 1 maraschino cherry, 1 tsp sugar and 3 dashes of aromatic bitters until the sugar dissolves. Fill with ice, add 50ml brandy and top with 60ml lemon-lime soda. Stir gently and garnish with another cherry and an orange slice. For non-drinkers, swap the brandy for cold black tea.
